title: Foo Bar Taxi Schema Evolution
description: Migrate a legacy taxi trips table that is missing columns and has a wrong column type, backfill defaults for existing rows, then ingest a new month of data in the updated format.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must evolve the schema of a 3M+ row ClickHouse table by adding missing columns (congestion_surcharge, airport_fee), converting payment_type from Int32 to String, backfilling defaults, and ingesting a second month of parquet data.

tasks.description: Add missing columns to the legacy taxi trips table, convert payment_type from Int32 to String, backfill existing rows with defaults, and ingest Feb 2024 data from /data/taxi/.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with analytics.taxi_trips_v1 containing Jan 2024 yellow taxi data (~3M rows) with a legacy schema missing congestion_surcharge and airport_fee columns, and payment_type stored as Int32. Feb 2024 parquet staged at /data/taxi/yellow_tripdata_2024-02.parquet.
